attempted_claim: Let (M^4,g) be a closed, oriented Riemannian 4-manifold with vanishing Bach tensor, positive Yamabe invariant Y(M^4,[g])>0 and integral of sigma_2(P_g) positive. If the conformal invariant beta(M^4,[g]) = (integral ||W_g||^2)/(integral sigma_2(P_g)) satisfies 4 <= beta(M^4,[g]) < 8, is (M^4,g) then conformally equivalent to (S^4,g_c) or to (CP^2,g_FS) up to orientation?
